text: [149] 59 aṭṭhime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa . katame aṭṭha sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno arahā arahattāya paṭipanno . ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā .pe. anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti . cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhānapāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalanti .
